limitations: No AWS or provider configuration mutation was performed for this qualification.
No live account, live mailbox, or hosted password-recovery acceptance is asserted.
The alias is configured explicitly only in the isolated session campaign; successful alias routing does not establish deployment of a friendly trial alias.
Readable workspace aliases can reveal existence when a valid alias redirects to the identity provider; uniform initial GET pages do not guarantee complete tenant-existence secrecy.
Email-based workspace discovery and global credential identity are not implemented by this change.
Full repository checks, independent review, browser appearance and release/deployment evidence are recorded separately by the integrating owner.

independent_ops_review.scope: Explicit window-local clean-trial alias context and continuity, with no remote operations

finding.description: Initial helper accepted noncanonical base32 padding bits, although the application rejects those handles and silently drops their aliases.
finding.disposition: Fixed with exact16-byte base32 decode/re-encode equality and a regression case; independent focused tests pass.

independent_ops_review.result: No remaining blocking finding in reviewed alias changes. New windows require explicit reviewed context; successors require the same mapping; synth and diff consume the same retained copy. Duplicate keys and malformed handles are rejected.
independent_ops_review.limitation: The helper validates syntax and continuity, not database ownership. A later deployment must compare the selected handle with the retained provision receipt for the existing trial.
